Marble Race Creator

Welcome marble racing fans!

Now Android version is also available HERE

Create your own tracks, races, runs and tournaments(planned) with this marble sandbox. Built in editor allows to create custom tracks.

The game is a follow up to marble racing game previously available for flash. It's under development but you can test early access version.

If you would like to make a suggestion, give ideas, complain or just chat - please join the discord server here.

Please use the in-game help. Enjoy!

Install instructions

Windows: please choose between 32 or 64 bit version depending on your system. Just unzip the file and run MRC.exe.

Mac: please install the Itch.io app and download the game through the app.

Linux: please unzip and then change properties of the file 'MRC_Linux_[VERSION]_app' to allow running it as executable. Then just run the file.
